name: L10 PanoLab reciprocal three-frame query sequence after frozen single-frame failure
question: Can two independently observed neighbouring query frames recover a search-priority candidate when one frozen anchor frame is severely occluded, without relaxing the score or margin gate?
observed_before_freeze: The sealed cross-collection single-frame result was observed: FP01 returned UNKNOWN and FP02 was accepted correctly. This protocol cannot supply fresh confirmation.

selection.episodes: Expand both FP01 and FP02, not only the failed row.
sequence: the anchor provider item's unique prev link
the anchor provider item's unique next link
selection.metadata_contract: Fetch only the exact provider item JSON named by each frozen link. Require same collection, exact linked ID, strict zero-pose projection eligibility, and reciprocal prev/next linkage back to the anchor.
selection.pixel_contract: No neighbouring image pixels, thumbnails, tiles, OCR, embeddings, scores, or human image review may be used in selection. Invalid metadata seals the row invalid; do not walk farther or substitute another frame.
selection.aggregation_frozen_for_later_evaluation: For each candidate target, compute the unchanged per-frame facade score for prev/anchor/next and use the arithmetic mean of the highest two of three frame scores. This requires two supporting observations while discarding one worst occluded frame.
selection.no_parameter_search: Sequence length three, top-two mean, unchanged crop, unchanged feature weights, and unchanged score/margin thresholds are one fixed structural hypothesis.

materialization.provider: Panoramax OpenStreetMap France HD asset recorded in each fetched provider item
materialization.anchor_policy: Reuse the two exact anchor files and hashes from the cross-collection positive materialization.
materialization.neighbor_policy: Download exactly four linked neighbours through item-specific .jpg.part files, atomically replace finals, and remove task-owned partials in a finally path.
materialization.overwrite: Refuse an existing selection, manifest, or output root.

research_basis.title: SeqNet: Learning Descriptors for Sequence-based Hierarchical Place Recognition
research_basis.use: Motivates short query sequences and selective sequence score aggregation. The proposed top-two mean is a small deterministic mechanism, not SeqNet.

research_basis.title: Learning Sequential Descriptors for Sequence-based Visual Place Recognition
research_basis.use: Motivates multi-view information and order-robust sequence representations. This protocol does not train or implement SeqVLAD.

research_basis.title: JIST: Joint Image and Sequence Training for Sequential Visual Place Recognition
research_basis.use: Motivates treating image and sequence evidence as complementary. This protocol does not train or implement SeqGeM.

claim_boundary.allowed: A frozen posthoc mechanism test of reciprocal three-frame query aggregation on both already consumed same-provider cross-collection targets.
not_allowed: provider-disjoint, city-disjoint, open-world, conformal, FDR-controlled, or deployment generalization
portal ownership, access, traversability, waypoint, arrival, handoff, user benefit, or safety
